findings.title: Switching episodes accumulates old captions and shows translations from different episodes together
findings.rule: Functional requirement: selected episode CC must match current English lesson; publish.md:42 (captions match spoken content).
findings.evidence: Normal Day02->Day03 leaves172 TC cues versus86 expected. At00:46 Day02 terminal dialogue translation and Day03 check-in queue translation are both active. ReturningDay02 yields258cues and3active translations.
findings.cause: offline/days_01-10/player.js:12 sets textTrack.mode=disabled before reading textTrack.cues; browser returns null, so removal loop skips retained cues.
findings.fix: Temporarily set each track hidden, remove old cues, add selected episode cues, then restore selected language; test every episode switch and all locales.

findings.title: Caption cue timing uses the longest language slot instead of each actual dubbed utterance
findings.rule: publish.md:158 says dubbed-language captions follow that dub timing; core/captions.mjs:6-14 describes measured cue timing.
findings.evidence: Day02 coach at126.141s uses common7.316sspeechwindow; English spoken duration5.597s, TC5.571s, SC5.244s, JA7.316s, KO6.824s. Each language caption is spread across7.316s. TC end thus trails its speech by1.745s; SC2.072s. Shared episode/audio duration is correct, but this does not establish cue-level synchronization.
findings.cause: scripts/produce.py:95,105-107 use n=max(language lengths) for all locale cues.
findings.fix: Keep shared video slots while cutting each selected-language CC against its measured speech timing; translate English character dialogue within its unchanged English slot.
